name: Exp_MACD_Xtr
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MACD_Xtr indicator, which is an enhanced MACD with volatility-based normalization using ATR, standard deviation, or volume as the source. It opens buy/sell positions on trend signals and closes them when the trend fades or reverses, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MACD_Xtr指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标是经过ATR、标准差或成交量归一化增强的MACD。它在趋势信号出现时开仓，在趋势消退或反转时平仓，并配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义MACD_Xtr指标产生动量交易信号。入场条件为：当指标信号值为2时开多仓（买入信号），当信号值为0时开空仓（卖出信号），且要求当前信号与前一根K线信号不同以确认趋势变化。出场条件包括：当信号值为1时表示无趋势，同时平掉多空仓位；也通过止损和止盈进行被动出场。仓位管理采用资金比例模式，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示账户资金的占比。资金管理依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数实现，支持基于存款份额的动态仓位计算。策略还包含信号灵敏度阈值(Sens)和前沿/阻尼平滑周期，用于过滤噪声信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA generates momentum trading signals based on the custom MACD_Xtr indicator, which enhances traditional MACD with volatility normalization using ATR, standard deviation, or tick volume as the source. Entry conditions are: when the indicator signal value equals 2, a buy position is opened (bullish signal), and when the signal value equals 0, a sell position is opened (bearish signal), requiring the current bar signal to differ from the previous bar to confirm a trend change. Exit conditions include: when the signal value equals 1 indicating no trend, both long and short positions are closed; passive exits also occur via configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing uses a deposit share model controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent the share of account balance per deal. Money management relies on functions from the external include file TradeAlgorithms.mqh, supporting dynamic position calculation based on deposit share. The strategy also incorporates a sensitivity threshold (Sens) and front/back smoothing periods to filter out noise from the signals.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易资金占比，负值表示固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade capital percentage; negative = fixed lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: 信号源类型（成交量/ATR/标准差）

parameters.name: Sens
parameters.description: 灵敏度阈值（点数或跳数）

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型（跳数/真实成交量）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用波动率归一化的增强MACD指标，比传统MACD更能适应不同市场波动环境
具有完整的止损止盈设置和买卖方向开关，风险控制参数较全面
信号处理采用前沿/阻尼平滑双重过滤，有效减少虚假信号
pros_en: Uses a volatility-normalized enhanced MACD indicator that adapts better to varying market volatility than traditional MACD
Includes complete stop loss/take profit settings and directional toggles for buy/sell, providing comprehensive risk control parameters
Signal processing employs front/damping dual smoothing filter, effectively reducing false signals
cons: 核心交易逻辑依赖外部文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh，无法独立评估完整的交易执行安全性
BackPeriod默认值444极大，可能导致指标响应严重滞后，错过大量交易机会
缺少点差过滤和最大持仓检查，在不利市场条件下可能导致额外损失
cons_en: Core trading logic depends on the external include file TradeAlgorithms.mqh, making it impossible to independently evaluate the complete trade execution safety
The default BackPeriod value of 444 is extremely large, potentially causing severe indicator lag and missing many trading opportunities
Lacks spread filtering and maximum position checks, which could lead to additional losses under adverse market conditions
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，避免在高点差时段开仓导致不必要的交易成本
增加最大同时持仓数量限制和资金最大回撤控制，提升整体资金安全性
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to avoid opening positions during high-spread periods that would incur unnecessary trading costs
Add maximum simultaneous position limits and maximum drawdown controls to improve overall capital safety

risk_points: 依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh的交易函数，其内部实现未经审查，可能存在仓位计算或执行逻辑缺陷
缺少点差过滤，在流动性差的市场时段可能以不利价格成交
止损止盈仅使用点数而非ATR动态调整，在不同波动率环境下可能不适用
risk_points_en: Depends on external include file TradeAlgorithms.mqh whose internal implementation is unreviewed, potentially containing position sizing or execution logic flaws
Lacks spread filtering, potentially executing at unfavorable prices during low-liquidity market sessions
Stop loss and take profit use fixed points rather than ATR-based dynamic adjustment, which may be inappropriate across different volatility environments

It opens buy/sell positions on trend signals and closes them when the trend fades or reverses, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
